Who we are

It started with these two

Music Flex Technology, LLC is a Washington, D.C. company with a simple mission: make the first steps of learning an instrument feel less like a chore and more like a game. The whole idea began at home — with our own kids and the notes they were learning to read. We started with the violin, and we're just getting started.

— Music Flex Technology · Washington, D.C.
